title: Return a value from a function
explanation:
A function can give a value back to its caller using return.
The parameter is a local copy when an int is passed by value.

questions.prompt: Which line returns twice the input?
questions.hint: Think about the difference between doubling and adding two.

options.feedback: Adding 2 only doubles the input when it is 2.
Returning n gives the original input.

questions.hint: n is a copy. The caller must keep the returned value.

options.feedback: The returned value 10 is stored back in score.

The result is returned but never stored.
score stays 5.
doubleValue takes an int, not an address.
